blocks.text: Francisi mahir-e-fitrat Jean-Baptiste Lamarck (1744-1829) evolution ke khayal ke ibtidai himayati the. Un ke khayal mein jandar saada tareen se paicheeda shaklon tak badle, aur jandaron mein tabdeeliyan mahol se dhalne ke dauran aati hain.

blocks.explanation: Francisi mahir-e-fitrat (1744-1829) aur evolution ke ibtidai himayati jinhon ne hasil shuda khasiyaton ki virasat pesh ki.

items: Lamarck: ibtidai irtiqa pasand; jandar dhalte hue saade se paicheeda tak badalte.
